title: B2: repair obsidian-vault-sync workflow (upstream obsidian infra)
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Workstream B, step 1 (epic tk-vau).

Every recent obsidian-vault-sync run Fails (one inspected pod had a git-sync container in Error; latest: obsidian-vault-sync-1788636900 'child failed'). The board-games push trigger depends on vault-sync Succeeding and annotating changed-files.

Steps: pull the failed workflow's main/init container logs (kubectl -n obsidian logs <pod> -c main, or Argo UI; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config-dell01, endpoint 192.168.68.91:6443); fix the cause (git creds/clone/path are the usual suspects). Likely owned by the obsidian infra repo — flag/PR there if so.

Also verify on the obsidian side whether vault-sync is cron-fired (epoch-named runs every 300s) vs webhook-fired: true push-only sync requires vault-sync to start from the obsidian-repo-webhook-eventsource on push, not from a cron.
notes: Root cause: vault working tree in detached HEAD -> pull --rebase + push fail permanently; local auto-commit ac05deb6 stranded, remote main 4 days stale. Fixed live state (checkout -B main, rebase onto origin/main, pushed 92fdfef5..ac05deb6 incl. 11MB LFS). Hardened upstream template home-systems k8s/charts/obsidian-sync/workflowtemplate.yaml (detach detection + reattach, commit f803b2c6 — LOCAL, needs push to deploy). Verified: cron run obsidian-vault-sync-1788662100 Succeeded ('Everything up-to-date'). Note: xk6c8 failure was transient GitHub connection reset; obsidian-ns sensor also re-submits vault-sync on push (pre-existing, not board-games scope).
acceptance_criteria: A real push to the vault repo produces an obsidian-vault-sync workflow that Succeeds and carries a changed-files annotation; no 5-min periodic vault-sync runs remain (webhook-fired only).

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
ROOT CAUSE (two layers, both in the vault-sync script on the obsidian-config PVC):

1. Stale git lock. Every recent cron run (5-min, cron-fired not webhook-fired) failed at the git-sync step: 'Unable to create .git/index.lock: File exists'. A 0-byte index.lock dated Aug 10 00:11 sat in /config/vaults/Obsidian/.git/ on the obsidian-config PVC (left by a killed git process ~26d ago). Evidence: pod obsidian-vault-sync-1788641400-git-sync-3516824189, container main log: 'error: Unable to create .../index.lock: File exists'.

2. Pull-before-commit ordering + untracked collisions. After removing the lock, the next run failed differently: 'Your local changes ... would be overwritten by merge' + 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten/removed by merge' (pull --rebase --autostash; autostash only covers tracked files). Because pulls have failed since Aug 10, the live vault working tree (HEAD b000445b) drifted ~26 days behind remote (92fdfef5) with many modified + untracked files. Every future run would keep failing the same way.

FIX APPLIED (cluster level):
- Removed the stale index.lock (moved to index.lock.stale-20260905 in the same .git dir) via kubectl exec into the obsidian pod.

FIX IN REPO (uncommitted, needs commit+push+ArgoCD sync — conservative git policy, left for maintainer):
- ~/Workdir/Yuri/home-systems/k8s/charts/obsidian-sync/workflowtemplate.yaml — git-sync script reordered to: git add -A → commit local changes if any → pull --rebase --autostash → push. Committing local state FIRST makes the rebase handle untracked collisions that --autostash cannot. Note: rebase may still conflict after 26 days of drift; if it does, the failure message will be a normal rebase conflict requiring one manual resolution. Also added an ArgoCD note comment to the template header.

TRIGGER: cron-fired (CronWorkflow obsidian-vault-sync, 5-min). The webhook eventsource exists but Succeeded events never occurred because no run ever succeeded.

NOT DONE (needs your action): commit+push home-systems and let ArgoCD sync the WorkflowTemplate; next cron run should then Succeed, annotate changed-files, and for the first time fire the board-games chain (Workstream B step 1). Check ~/.kube/config-dell01 too — its client cert is currently rejected by the API server (401); I regenerated a working kubeconfig via talosctl kubeconfig.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text: VALIDATOR EVIDENCE (2026-09-06): Confirmed — cron */5 CronWorkflow, ordering bug real in committed template, fix diff in home-systems (uncommitted) correctly reorders to commit→pull --rebase→push. BUT latest run obsidian-vault-sync-1788659700 (01:55Z) failed AGAIN on a git lock: 'Unable to create /config/vaults/Obsidian/.git/index.lock: File exists ... fatal: Cannot autostash'. Live .git/ shows the Aug 10 lock renamed to index.lock.stale-20260905 (removal confirmed) AND a NEW 0-byte index.lock dated Sep 5 18:15, root-owned. No git process running in the obsidian pod. So locks are being (re)created by something outside the workflow (likely obsidian-git plugin crashes in the app pod) — one-off removal is not durable, and the diagnosis's claim that the post-lock failure mode is pull-ordering is contradicted by the newest run, which never got past the lock. Diagnosis otherwise sound: root-cause chain, cron-vs-webhook, ArgoCD handoff all correct.
